title: Returning a received special-order part and resolving cores (OK/Not OK) is allowed with Work Orders → View, without Work Order Line: Create & Edit
custom_preconds:
1. You have a role with Work Orders → View turned ON but Work Order Line: Create & Edit turned OFF.
  2. A user is signed in with that role.
  3. A work order has a special-order part that has already been received, and a part with a core to resolve.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. From the part's three-dot menu, return the received special-order part.
  3. Resolve a core (choose OK or Not OK) for an inventory part and a special-order part.
custom_expected:
The user IS able to return the received special-order part and resolve the cores.

These actions are gated by Work Orders → View (not by Work Order Line: Create & Edit) — this matches the current spec ("Marking Cores OK/Not Ok is gated by WO→View") and behaves the same on Production.
pending: PM confirmation of intended rule (ticket Open, fast-follow). If PM rules these must require Work Order Line: Create & Edit, this becomes a Deviation.

POST /api/work-orders/{id}/pre-resolve-cores {cores:[]} = 400 'At least one core is required' (PERMISSION PASSED, not 403). POST /api/work-orders/part/make-return-request {} = 400 'part_id/quantity/return_reason missing' (PERMISSION PASSED, not 403). A control role with NO WO permissions reached the same 400 validation. Conclusion: these endpoints are NOT blocked by a Work Order Line: Create & Edit 403 — matches ticket (same as Prod) + current spec. Full action-completion with a seeded received part+core not driven to 201 this run (impersonation contention).
